metadata.query: How can I annihilate the bed bugs in my house?

final_answer: To annihilate bed bugs in your house, you can use insecticides such as permethrin, cypermethrin, or deltamethrin. Heat treatment, which involves raising the temperature to over 120°F for several hours, is another effective method. Lastly, diatomaceous earth, a natural substance, can also be used to control bed bug infestations. (Sources: University of Minnesota Extension, National Pest Management Association, EPA)
